snippet.title: Wish Upon A Llama | Whitethorn Games Partnership Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
As announced at the Cozy Games Showcase Awards May 28, 2026, Millionhare Studios is partnering with Whitethorn Games to publish their upcoming title: Wish Upon A Llama!

Wish Upon A Llama is a cozy life sim RPG for animal lovers! As Llama Town's rancher, breed and raise adorable furry friends while rekindling a forgotten bond between the community and animals. Get to know the townsfolk, build lasting friendships, and perhaps discover romance. Adventure awaits!

Wishlist Wish Upon A Llama on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2262630/Wish_Upon_A_Llama/
